title: More Ocean Changed Color Than All Earth's Land
hook: Satellites found a planet-sized ocean shift happening in plain sight.
closing: Ocean color tracks microscopic life, so this vast shift could signal ecosystem change.
question: What could be changing the color?

segments.say: Color changed across 56 percent of the ocean surface. Most of the sea now looks measurably different.
A model predicted 50 percent would change. Satellites later observed even more, matching the warning at planetary scale.
The changed ocean covers 203 million square kilometers. That exceeds all Earth's land combined.
